clips.title: The story
paras: The Crusader's Armory is a fortified interior hall within the Scarlet Monastery Armory wing. Stockpiled with munitions, gunpowder, and cannonballs, it serves as a staging ground for the zealots guarding the path toward the inner sanctum. Beyond its locked iron door lies the Hall of Champions.

Situated between the Footman's Armory and the grand Hall of Champions, the Crusader's Armory displays the full military readiness of the Scarlet Crusade. Unlike the training yards outside, these narrow stone corridors are packed to the ceiling with crates of volatile gunpowder, stacked cannonballs, and heavily armed crusaders ready to repel intruders. The Crusade has turned a former monastic compound into a bristling fortress, dedicating every available hall to the tools of total war. At the far end of the armory stands a heavy locked iron door, barring entry to the inner chambers unless one holds the Scarlet Key.
